title: Phenomena showing up around nuclear bases

plain: A writer and researcher named Graham Hancock, speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that unexplained phenomena have been showing up around nuclear weapons bases. He does not name a source or a place, but says he finds the pattern interesting, since it would hint that whatever is behind them takes an interest in nuclear weapons.
